name: summer-cycle
description: A Studio Ghibli / Makoto Shinkai style cycling game in Three.js. Toon-shaded Japanese countryside with four times of day - every mesh, texture and sound generated in code.

paragraphs: A bicycle ride down a Japanese country road on a late-summer afternoon, drawn in the manner of a Ghibli or Makoto Shinkai background painting and built in Three.js. There is no score and nothing to win; you ride past flooded paddies, a row of old wooden shops and power lines sagging over the road, and the sun goes down if you let it. Everything on screen and everything you hear is generated in code at load time: the meshes, the leaf atlas the trees are painted with, the Japanese shop signs, the clouds, and every sound, which is synthesized with the Web Audio API. The repository ships no…
Captured from the running build with tools/reel.mjs, one simulated frame at a time. Nothing in it is composited or edited.
For a hands-off recording: ?autoplay=1 rides by itself with no UI, and ?autoplay=1&timelapse=1 sets the sun from afternoon to dusk over 40 seconds.
